div.head: List of Abbreviations and Symbols
div.p: Editor’s note. This list does not include standard abbreviations in common usage and those abbreviations and contractions which, although uncommon, are understandable from the context.

list.item: BdD, Bund der Deutschen (Federation of Germans)
BHE, Bund der Heimatvertriebenen und Entrechteten (League of Expellees and Disenfranchised)

GARIOA, Government and Relief in Occupied Areas

TO&E, table of organization and equipment
